name: The Society of the Open Eye
tagline: A white marble hall behind a bank's locked doors, and a great eye that never closes.
era: An invented capital, in no particular year
summary: Raise the society's secrets to 100 while keeping loyalty at 50 or more. Refuse the inner circle if it demands a forbidden rite.
action.tap_a_shoulder.desc: Hand a brass key to someone useful. Adds followers and a little scrutiny; new faces ease paranoia.
action.trade_a_secret.desc: Sell a whisper from the archive to a powerful client. Adds funds and a few secrets.
action.gaze_into_the_eye.desc: Stand before the Eye and confess what you have seen. Raises secrets and loyalty and hides the society from outsiders, but feeds the zealots' paranoia.
codex.fall.exposed: A clerk walked out with the membership ledger, and every name was in the morning papers. The society dissolved within the week. (Game ending.)
